name: Equity dip-buy gated by a non-inverted yield curve (long)
rationale: EQUITY SEGMENT + REGIME-SWITCHING on an equity-only macro switch (yield_curve_2s10s). The 2s10s curve slope is the most-watched recession/regime gauge: a steep/positive curve signals an expansion where equity dips are buyable, while an INVERTED curve (negative slope) precedes recessions where dip-buying is a trap. This gates an EQUITY mean-reversion (oversold dip-buy) by the curve regime — fire the dip only when the curve is NOT inverted. Mechanism before data: long when yield_curve_2s10s is above a fitted slope floor (curve not inverted) AND RSI is oversold (the dip); exit on RSI recovery or barriers. Distinct from g2-equity-credit-spread-calm-momentum (credit gate on MOMENTUM), g2-macro-regime-gated-reversion (crypto, and macro_regime happens to equal the curve in current data — but THIS one is equity-class and uses the curve explicitly as the recession switch), and the equity TAA arms (allocation models). Note macro_regime and yield_curve_2s10s currently carry identical values in prod; this spec is on the EQUITY class and frames the curve as the recession switch, the crypto macro-regime spec is on crypto — the two test the same gauge on different asset classes, a deliberate cross-asset generalization check, not a duplicate. Disconfirmer 1: drop the curve gate — if bare equity oversold dip-buying matches the deflated Sharpe, the curve regime adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: if the curve never inverts in-sample, the gate is a constant and selects nothing. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): yield_curve_2s10s is daily next-day-available; net of equity costs the reversion must clear. tier0 yield_curve_2s10s + tier0 rsi (equity), has prod data — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: oversold equity price gated to fire ONLY when the 2s10s yield curve is not inverted (expansion regime) — curve-gated equity reversion
